text: Ha ha ha! Hahahahaha! Ha ha ha ha! Hahahahaha!
prompt: An expressive adult woman with a clear natural mezzo-soprano voice, a slightly smoky lower register and bright resonant laughter in her middle register. She performs a real, wild, explosive maniacal laugh. Uncontrollable gleeful cackling with strong projection and a full open mouth. Laugh rapidly and continuously for four seconds, with the same energetic intensity and rhythm throughout. Short distinct ha-ha-ha pulses tumbling naturally into each other, without phrase pauses. This is delighted hysterical laughter, not grunting, shouting words, or sustaining a vowel. Start at full laughing force, stay there, finish with one emphatic laugh and stop abruptly. Clean dry studio recording. No quiet chuckles, slowing, sighing, gasping, moaning, music or effects.
based_on: Original strong female siege-laugh direction; new continuous performance, no reference audio or reused samples
